name: ⚔️Sword Battles⚔️
desc:
⚠️ GAME CONTAINS FLASHING LIGHTS ⚠️

Fight other people with 300+ swords to obtain. Different swords have different abilities. 
The game can be very annoying and chaotic so be warned. 
(Abilities can be activated with the “E” key, if you’re on mobile there will be a button to press).

GAME RULES

NO EXPLOITING
NO BAN EVADING
NO DISRESPECT/TOXICITY
NO ADVERTISING
NO BEGGING
NO GLITCH ABUSING

You can type ";report (Username) (Report Reason)" to report rule breakers. 
(The username is capital sensitive, meaning if its: "aBc", you'll have to type "aBc" instead of "abc")

(You can join the Community Server via the Sword Battles group to see the detailed version of the game rules.)

(Thanks DM DORUKO for the music)
(and Miza too for the music: "Miza - Dark World")

Credits to Our_Unity for making the rules.
Credits to Pixedex for making the game art.
